EMK Capital has closed a €1.25bn single-asset continuation fund at its hard cap, with LGT Capital Partners acting as co-lead investor, to retain ownership of European technical installation services group VDK Groep and provide additional capital for acquisitions.

NeoGenesis Capital has launched its debut venture capital fund targeting businesses developed using the genetic engineering platform of Colossal Biosciences, the US biotechnology company best known for its attempts to revive extinct species.

EQT has agreed to acquire Australian waste management group Cleanaway in a A$9.3bn ($6.5bn) deal through its EQT Infrastructure VI fund.

Evercore has appointed its private capital advisory chief Nigel Dawn as co-president alongside investment banking executive Naveen Nataraj, elevating the head of its secondaries and private capital advisory business into the firm's senior executive leadership.

UK private equity manager Graphite Capital has returned to fundraising with a £500m target for its tenth flagship buyout fund, ending an eight-year gap since the close of its previous vehicle.

Nauta Capital has secured €60m at the first close of its sixth venture capital fund, with the British Business Bank returning as an anchor investor for the fourth successive generation of the European software investment strategy.

Pear VC has raised $333m for its fifth flagship venture capital fund, down almost 23% from its previous vehicle.

Global infrastructure fundraising remained 39% below last year's levels during the first nine months of 2026 despite a sharp third-quarter rebound, with three megafunds accounting for almost two-thirds of the capital raised during the latest quarter.

US alternative asset manager Bow River Capital has appointed private equity investment chief Greg Hiatrides as chief executive, succeeding founder Blair Richardson after 23 years leading the business.

AltAssets has been serving the global private equity industry for over a decade and has become established as a trusted source of independent news and views on the industry by thousands of professionals worldwide.
